texts.MyShortLinks:Description: Create, manage, and measure your short links.
texts.Title: Title
texts.DeleteConfirmation: Delete this short link? Its code will remain unavailable during the cooldown period.
texts.BlockedDomainImport:Title: Import blocked domains
texts.BlockedDomainImport:Description: Upload a UTF-8 CSV file with a required Domain column and an optional Reason column.
texts.BlockedDomainImport:FileRequired: Select a CSV file to upload.
texts.BlockedDomainImport:Summary: Rows: {0}; imported: {1}; already existed: {2}; duplicate in file: {3}; invalid: {4}.
texts.BlockedDomainImport:DuplicateInFile: The normalized domain already appeared in this file.
texts.BlockedDomainImport:AlreadyExists: The domain already exists and was not changed.
texts.ShortLinkDomains:Description: Configure the origins that can serve short links for this tenant.
texts.ShortLinkDomains:OriginHelp: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin only, without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
texts.Quota:NotGranted: Creating short links is not currently available for this account. Existing links remain available to manage.
texts.Quota:Full: Your short-link quota is full. Delete a link to make room before creating another.
texts.Quota:OverLimit: Your usage exceeds the current quota. Existing links are unchanged, but you cannot create more until usage is below the limit.
texts.Quota:ExternallyManaged: Link quotas are managed by an external capability provider. The maximum links per user setting is retained for standalone use and does not control the active quota.
texts.CustomCodeQuota:NotGranted: Custom codes are not available for this account. Leave the field empty to generate a code automatically.
texts.CustomCodeQuota:Full: Your custom-code quota is full. Delete a custom-code link or leave the field empty to generate a code automatically.
texts.CustomCodeQuota:OverLimit: Your custom-code usage exceeds the current limit. Existing links are unchanged; delete custom-code links before creating another.
texts.CustomCodeQuota:InputUnavailable: Leave this field empty to generate a code automatically.
texts.Statistics:Unavailable: Statistics are not currently available for this account.
texts.Gone:Title: This short link is no longer available
texts.Gone:Description: The short link '{0}' has expired, was disabled, or was deleted.
texts.Blocked:Title: The destination has been blocked
texts.Blocked:Description: This short link points to the blocked domain '{0}'.
texts.NotFound:Title: Short link not found

texts.ShortLinkPath:Immutable: The namespace and path are fixed at creation and cannot be changed.
texts.RootPath:QuotaHelp: Root links consume both the root-path and total-link quotas. Custom codes also consume the custom-code quota.
texts.DefaultNamespace:Help: Use 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; names are case-sensitive. Applies to new links only. All former defaults remain reserved; existing URLs never change.
texts.Namespaces:Description: Namespaces belong to one domain. Names and domain bindings cannot be changed.
texts.Namespaces:NameHelp: Use 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Names are case-sensitive. System route prefixes (such as admin, subscriptions, api, auth and static) and current or former defaults are reserved.
texts.Namespaces:DeletionHelp: A namespace cannot be deleted while any link references it, including deleted links. Listing and deletion remain available after feature expiry or quota downgrades.
texts.Namespaces:DeleteConfirmation: Delete this namespace? It must not be referenced by any link, including deleted links.
texts.Namespaces:UnavailableHelp: New user namespaces and new links in them are unavailable. Existing links still work and can be managed; unused namespaces can be deleted.
texts.Namespaces:CapabilitiesUnavailable: Namespace quotas and domain choices require short-link list permission. Enter an eligible Origin; the server checks permissions, domain access and entitlements before creating a namespace.
texts.Namespaces:SelectionUnavailable: The selected namespace is unavailable for this domain. Choose another path.
texts.Namespaces:SelectionPermissionRequired: Namespace list permission is required to select a user namespace.
texts.Namespaces:SelectDomainHelp: Select a domain to load your namespaces. The system default remains available.
texts.Namespaces:SelectHelp: Choose the system default or one of your namespaces on this domain.
texts.Namespaces:NoneForDomain: You have no namespaces on this domain. Use the system default or an eligible root path.
texts.Namespaces:LoadFailed: Namespaces could not be loaded. Retry, or select the system default or an eligible root path.
texts.Quota:Zero: Your total-link limit is zero. Existing links remain available to manage.

texts.RootLinkQuota:NotGranted: Creating root-path links is not granted. Existing addresses remain unchanged.

texts.RootLinkQuota:InputUnavailable: The root path is unavailable under your current quota. Choose a namespace instead.
